name: axolotl
description: Provides guidance for fine-tuning large language models with Axolotl, covering YAML training configs, LoRA and QLoRA, preference training with DPO, KTO, ORPO and GRPO, multimodal models, FSDP and multi-GPU setups, sequence (context) parallelism, NCCL bandwidth tests, dataset formats, compressed model saving for vLLM and llmcompressor, and custom integrations. Use when writing or debugging an Axolotl YAML config, choosing a dataset format for a fine-tuning run, setting up FSDP or context_parallel
author: KalarisLabs
